title: Patriarchy: The debate we all should have, beyond religion and ancient texts
description: We could spend endless hours arguing about a single verse in any ancient text. It makes for good television. It won’t free a single woman. The job isn’t to rebuild the past; it’s to build something better going forward, with the Constitution as the guide.
